chonk.beside.archive: an archive of the same name beside it
chonk.beside.folder: a folder of the same name beside it
chonk.confirm.file: {0}. It can be brought back from the Recycle Bin.
chonk.confirm.folder.many: {0}, with {1} files inside it. It can be brought back from the Recycle Bin.
chonk.confirm.folder.one: {0}, with 1 file inside it. It can be brought back from the Recycle Bin.
chonk.description: Where the room on a drive went, biggest first, and how each drive has grown since last week; clears out what you no longer want.
chonk.drives.hint: Open a drive to pick a folder inside it, then Scan. Sizes only, nothing is opened, so this is far quicker than a Purrge scan over the same tree.
chonk.empty: Nothing measured yet. Pick a drive on the left, or choose a folder, and press Scan.
chonk.extract.cost: {0} files, {1}, into a new folder {2} beside it.
chonk.extract.cost.free: {0} files, {1}, into a new folder {2} beside it. The drive has {3} free.
chonk.extract.failed: {0} was not unpacked, and nothing was left behind: {1}
chonk.extract.promise: Nothing is overwritten, and the archive stays where it is. Every file is checked against the archive afterwards; only when all of them are there does the archive count as a copy you can bin.
chonk.extract.refused.empty: There is nothing in it to unpack.
chonk.extract.refused.notzip: Only zip archives can be unpacked here. 7-Zip does the rest.
chonk.extract.refused.password: It wants a password. 7-Zip can unpack it; Meows cannot.
chonk.extract.refused.room: It unpacks to {0}, and the drive has {1} free.
chonk.extract.refused.there: A folder called {0} is already beside it. Nothing is unpacked over anything; if it holds the same files, Chonk says so when the archive is selected.
chonk.extract.refused.unreadable: It could not be opened, so nothing was unpacked.
chonk.extract.unverified: {0} unpacked into {1}, but the check did not agree: {2}
chonk.extract.verified: {0} unpacked into {2} and checked: all {1} files are there, byte for byte. The archive is now a copy.
chonk.glance: {0} holds {1}; {2} is the biggest part at {3}
chonk.page.description: Measures where the room on a drive went, biggest first, and clears out what you no longer want.
chonk.records.recycled: sent something to the Recycle Bin
chonk.secondlook: Worth a second look before removing this.
chonk.status.removed: Sent {0} to the Recycle Bin, {1} freed
chonk.status.start: Pick a drive, or a folder inside one, then Scan.
chonk.twin: Paid for twice. Whichever side you remove, the other keeps all of it.
chonk.warn.game: This is a Steam game, and deleting the folder leaves Steam still believing it is installed. Uninstall it through Steam instead.
chonk.warn.inuse: Something has a file in here open right now.
chonk.warn.twin: The same files are in {0} beside it, so nothing is lost.
chonk.warn.twin.extras: {0} files in here are not in {1} beside it, and those would be gone. Remove the archive instead to lose nothing.
chonk.wholefolder: A folder goes whole, with everything inside it. Everything goes to the Recycle Bin, so it can be brought back.
weighin.about: A reading keeps folder totals to that depth, a few thousand numbers on a full drive, and the last sixty readings are kept. A drive under 10% free and still shrinking is said on the notification surface until it is not.
weighin.action.measure.hint: Measures every drive the way the button does, so what grew is known now rather than at the next daily pass.
weighin.action.unknown: Weigh-In does not know how to “{0}”.
weighin.budget.next: {0} is measured at the next reading; Read now does it straight away.
weighin.budget.pick: The folder to keep under a budget
weighin.budget.unmeasured: Budget {0}; measured at the next reading
weighin.budgets.hint: A line a folder is not meant to cross, checked at every reading. Over it, a warning stays up until the folder is under it again. A folder meant to be full needs no budget.
weighin.description: Measures every drive once a day and says what grew: which drive lost how much since last week, and the folders responsible.
weighin.empty: No reading yet. The first one walks every drive, which takes as long as a Chonk scan of each; after that, one a day on the shell's clock, and Purr lists it.
weighin.error.chonk: Chonk did not take the folder.
weighin.growth.hint: Deepest folders that moved, without the parents that only moved because of them. Below the threshold on the right is left out.
weighin.growth.none: Nothing moved by more than the threshold.
weighin.headline.grew: {0} lost {1} since {2}; {3}% free. The folders responsible:
weighin.headline.shrank: {0} gained {1} back since {2}; {3}% free. What went:
weighin.job.measure: Take a reading of every drive
weighin.job.measure.hint: The same reading the tab takes on its schedule, for Task Scheduler. While Windows runs it, the tab's own schedule stands down.
weighin.job.nodrives: There are no drives to read.
weighin.outside: Task Scheduler takes the readings; this pass stands down.
weighin.records.overbudget: found a folder over its budget
weighin.records.reading: took a reading of a drive
weighin.status.cancelled: Reading stopped. The last one stands.
weighin.status.start: Nothing read yet. The first reading starts on its own; after that, one a day.
weighin.warn.line: {0}: {1} free, {2} less than a week ago
weighin.warn.many: {0} drives are nearly full and still filling
weighin.warn.one: A drive is nearly full and still filling
